justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/StreamDrainer.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/StreamDrainerTest.java`. The class is a small, single-purpose utility: 1 public operation (`drain(InputStream)`), 2 constructors, and a few constants, all centered on one responsibility of copying an `InputStream` into a `byte[]` (about 101 lines total). The dedicated test covers that one behavior, and other references in `ClassFileLocator`/`Plugin` are only consumers. I did not find evidence of multiple distinct responsibilities or excessive modular breakdown needs.
